conductor_damage.voltage_pattern: Sudden voltage drop to near-zero on affected section
conductor_damage.current_pattern: Current drops sharply or spikes momentarily then drops
conductor_damage.typical_cause: Physical wire snap, corrosion, storm damage

transformer_overload.voltage_pattern: Gradual voltage sag over sustained period
transformer_overload.typical_cause: Excess simultaneous load, summer peak demand

vegetation_contact.description: Tree branch or vegetation touching live line
vegetation_contact.typical_cause: Untrimmed trees near feeder lines, monsoon growth

illegal_connection.voltage_pattern: Localized voltage drop in specific section
illegal_connection.current_pattern: Current higher than expected for registered load
